answer.why_different: D1–D3 are different metadata values, likely because the generator used the broader TS 28.532 document identity and an older document year/release instead of the specific Provisioning MnS metadata. answer.spec_3gpp: The specification consistently identifies the API as the Provisioning MnS, including the statement that the data types are used by the Provisioning MnS and the table entry describing Resource as part of the present specification. The supplied specification passages do not establish whether release 18.2.0 or 18.0.0 is the correct metadata version or copyright year.
answer.openapi: The Info Object requires title and version and permits a description; its version identifies the OpenAPI document. Info Objects may be extended with specification extensions, so x-openapi-generator is structurally allowed.
answer.clearer_why: The official metadata identifies the specific Provisioning MnS and includes the complete copyright and rights statement. The generated metadata is broader and potentially misleading because it labels the API only as generic TS 28.532 management services.

The version values differ, but the supplied specification passages do not establish which release/version should be recorded. OpenAPI requires a document version but does not select between 18.2.0 and 18.0.0; see O3, C1, and C2.

The generated description misidentifies the API as generic TS 28.532 management services, uses a different year, and omits “All rights reserved.” The specification names the Provisioning MnS, while the official description preserves the specific identity and rights statement; see S7 and C1.
